label.zh: 加利福尼亚州 — 税务咨询

institutions: California Department of Tax and Fee Administration

goals: Distinguish domicile, residency, and filing status without guessing
Report income and withholding; separate tax from refund
Never swap deduction and credit — they do different math
Distinguish sales tax collected from use tax owed
Preserve protest deadlines exactly — a missed date can end the argument

definition.en: Domicile is your true permanent home; residency for California tax can attach by presence and purpose. They are related, not identical.

distinctions.difference: Presence, domicile, and statutory residency answer different questions. Collapsing them files the wrong return — or two.

misconceptions.description: Equating residency with simply being present
misconceptions.diagnosticPrompt: Taxpayer: 'I only slept here for work.' Interpret why domicile still gets asked.

examples.en: California residency and domicile are separate questions, so we document both.
examples.es: La residencia y el domicilio en California son preguntas distintas, así que documentamos ambas.
examples.zh: 加州的居住地和住所是两个不同的问题，因此两者都要记录。

definition.en: The category (single, married filing jointly/separately, head of household) that sets brackets and many eligibility rules.

distinctions.difference: Filing status is a tax category with tests (e.g., head of household), not just whether someone is married.

misconceptions.description: Treating filing status as plain marital status
misconceptions.diagnosticPrompt: Interpret: 'Head of household has its own tests.' What must not be assumed from 'single parent'?

examples.en: Your filing status sets the brackets, so we confirm it before any numbers.
examples.es: Su estado civil tributario define los tramos, así que lo confirmamos antes de cualquier cifra.
examples.zh: 您的报税身份决定税档，因此我们先确认它再谈数字。

definition.en: Tax already taken from pay during the year and credited on the return — prepayment, not the final tax itself.

distinctions.difference: Withholding is what was prepaid; liability is what is owed. Refund or balance due is the difference — swapping terms panics or over-promises.

misconceptions.diagnosticPrompt: W-2 shows $4,000 withheld. Is that 'the tax'? Interpret the preparer's next sentence carefully.

examples.en: Withholding is the prepaid credit; your final tax is computed after.
examples.es: La retención es el crédito prepagado; su impuesto final se calcula después.
examples.zh: 预扣税是已预缴的抵免；最终税额随后计算。

definition.en: Periodic prepayments of expected tax on income without withholding (self-employment, investments), to avoid underpayment penalties.

distinctions.difference: Estimates pay as you earn through the year; filing settles the account. Waiting until April can add penalties even if the total matches.

examples.en: Without withholding, estimated payments keep you ahead of penalties.
examples.es: Sin retención, los pagos estimados le mantienen por delante de las sanciones.
examples.zh: 没有预扣时，预估付款可帮助您避免罚款。

definition.en: A deduction lowers taxable income; a credit lowers the tax itself, dollar for dollar. Same dollars, different math entirely.

distinctions.difference: $1,000 deduction at 9.3% saves ~$93; $1,000 credit saves $1,000. Swapping the words misprices advice by an order of magnitude.

misconceptions.diagnosticPrompt: Client hears '$1,000 credit' as '$1,000 deduction.' Interpret the preparer's correction with the math intact.

examples.en: Remember: a deduction lowers income, a credit lowers the tax itself.
examples.es: Recuerde: una deducción reduce el ingreso, un crédito reduce el impuesto mismo.
examples.zh: 请记住：扣除减少应税收入，抵免直接减少税额本身。

es.term: impuesto sobre ventas frente a impuesto sobre uso

zh.term: 销售税与使用税的区别

definition.en: Sales tax is collected by the seller at purchase; use tax is owed by the buyer when sales tax was not collected on goods used in California.

distinctions.difference: Who collects and who remits flips between the two. An owner who only knows 'sales tax' misses use-tax liability on out-of-state equipment.

misconceptions.diagnosticPrompt: Owner bought equipment online, tax-free. Interpret why use tax still gets assessed.

examples.en: If sales tax was not collected, use tax may still be owed in California.
examples.es: Si no se cobró el impuesto sobre ventas, aún puede deberse el impuesto sobre uso en California.
examples.zh: 如果未征收销售税，在加州可能仍需缴纳使用税。

en.term: Notice of Proposed Assessment — protest deadline

es.term: notificación de liquidación propuesta — plazo de protesta

zh.term: 拟议评税通知——抗议期限

definition.en: FTB's proposed additional tax notice; protesting in writing within the stated deadline (commonly 60 days) preserves appeal rights.

distinctions.difference: The protest deadline is jurisdictional in effect: miss it and the assessment can become final. Dates here are rights, not reminders.

misconceptions.description: Rendering protest deadline as flexible reminder
misconceptions.diagnosticPrompt: Interpret: 'You have 60 days to protest in writing.' What happens to tone if 'deadline' becomes 'when you can'?

examples.en: This notice gives you sixty days to protest in writing — that deadline protects your rights.
examples.es: Esta notificación le da sesenta días para protestar por escrito: ese plazo protege sus derechos.
examples.zh: 本通知给予您六十天书面抗议期——该期限保护您的权利。
